results.message:
Pivot/origin check did not meet the recommended score (score=0.20, recommended >=0.70). Reported as SKIPPED, not a failure: the correct pivot location depends on the object type, so a sub-threshold result is advisory and does not fail FET001. The tilt and spin videos are kept below so the pivot can be judged visually.
Pivot is 62.9% from base (should be <10%).
X-axis tilt causes ground penetration (min_z=-0.642).

How to fix:
- Move the asset pivot to the bottom-center of the bounding box.
- The pivot should be at Z=0 (ground level) and centered in XY.
- In your DCC tool, set the pivot/origin to the base of the object.
- Check the X-tilt and Z-spin videos for visual reference.

When this can be ignored: this check validates ground-placeable
props. If your object is a rotating/hinged type (e.g., door, robot
joint), the pivot should be at the rotation center -- not the base;
those are validated under FET021/FET022. Attached objects (cameras,
wheels) should have their pivot at the attachment point.

INTERIM: pivot/origin (VG.025) is treated as advisory and does not
fail the feature, pending spec clarification on whether VG.025 is a
mandatory or optional requirement (refer to docs/spec-clarifications-needed.md).
